limits: Measured guard wall seconds include failures with final receipts; they are not total research wall time, CPU-seconds, or agent cost.
Any interrupted guard without a final receipt is excluded; elapsed time and peak RSS are never inferred from note timestamps.

Acquisition/reproduction, qualification, finite controls, fixed-input performance and installed validation are classified separately. Native bootstrap acquisition includes its internal generation checks; its outer guard is counted once.
Archive maintenance, editing, analysis, idle gaps and external jobs are not included. Missing timing means observed totals are a lower bound, even after phase completion.
